thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to #incidents — streaming endpoint /v1/stream/generate is experiencing p99 spikes and partial stalls since ~03:22 UTC. Thresholds breached: p95=1.8s (SLO 1.0s), p99=6.2s (SLO 3.0s).

oncall_sre_ash: acked. grabbing logs, posting initial triage.

oncall_sre_ash: quick note — customer telemetry shows increase in aborted streams and reconnects. Multiple regions (us-east, eu-west) affected but us-east is worst.

prod_support_jordan: flagged top 2 customers seeing errors: AcmeCorp (session aborts), EduLabs (long pauses). CS notified.

ml_infra_maya: looking at deployment history — we rolled a precision profile update (int8 calibration checkpoint v2.3) to streaming nodes at 03:15 UTC. Calibration job completed but with warnings on certain heads.

runtime_eng_lee: that correlates timeline-wise. Could be calibration fallout causing KV cache miss churn or decoder stalls.

oncall_sre_ash: can you grab recent runtime logs for one affected stream? paste any stack traces or stalls.

ml_infra_maya: pasting snippet from node-rt-42 logs:```
[03:21:58] stream: call_id=abc123 stalled at decode loop (kv-miss) seq=512
[03:22:01] quant: fallback_check failed for tile=conv_7 (calib mismatch)
[03:22:05] runtime: queue-depth high=128, worker-latency p99=5.9s
```

oncall_sre_ash: hmm. "calib mismatch" + kv-miss fits quantization calibration mismatch causing more cache churn.

se_customer_eng_arjun: customers reporting streaming partial payloads (they get token bursts then long silence). Are we seeing any memory spikes or OOMs?

runtime_eng_lee: memory looks steady. It's timing out inside the decoder kernel when quantized paths hit unexpected values, causing retry and slow dequant path. This increases tail latency.

ml_infra_maya: experiment log shows ~4% of tokens fell back to slower fp16 dequant path after the new int8 profile. Under normal load that's fine but under bursts it amplifies queuing.

oncall_sre_ash: impact summary for paging — p50 slightly up, p95 broken, p99 far over SLO, streaming stalls manifest as hanging connections requiring client reconnects (customer-visible).

prod_support_jordan: CS estimates ~12 impacted customer sessions in the last 30m, 3 of which aborted. Need communication template.

ops_manager_rita: escalate to incident? yes. Open incident, notify ENG leads and start mitigation playbook.

incident-bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-328 — Latency spike / streaming stalls after precision profile roll. Incident lead: oncall_sre_ash. Paging: runtime_eng_lee, ml_infra_maya, prod_support_jordan.

oncall_sre_ash: mitigation plan attempt 1 — enable routing fallback to fp16 variant (non-quantized) for streaming endpoints for 15m to drain queues, then evaluate. Who can flip the route?

runtime_eng_lee: I can push a temporary routing rule: route streaming -> model:stream-latest:fp16 when precision==int8 AND latency>3000ms. Running config change now.

runtime_eng_lee: pushed rule. curl snippet for internal ops:```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/stream/generate","policy":"force_variant:fp16","ttl_s":900}'
```

oncall_sre_ash: monitor p95/p99 and in-flight streams.

ml_infra_maya: starting controlled rollback of int8 calibration checkpoint v2.3 on streaming pools (canary first). I'll coordinate with runtime to ensure no double-routing.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started: calib-v2.3 -> rollback -> calib-v2.2 on pool streaming-prod-01 (canary 10%).

prod_support_jordan: contacting AcmeCorp & EduLabs with initial note: "We're investigating streaming stalls; temporary routing fix applied. We'll follow up with status in 30m."

se_customer_eng_arjun: customer response — AcmeCorp: "we see improvements but occasional token pauses still visible on one session" — they provided a sample session id abc123.

ml_infra_maya: can reproduce with session abc123 on canary nodes; rollback completed on canary and those sessions look normal. Now ramping rollback to 50%.

runtime_eng_lee: p99 dropped from 6.2s -> 2.4s on canary subset. Global p99 trending down from 6.2s to 3.1s since routing rule + rollback started.

oncall_sre_ash: good. continuing monitoring. if p99 < 3.0s for 10m, we can expand rollback to 100% and keep routing rule for 5m to let drains finish.

ml_infra_maya: expanding rollback to 100% on streaming pools. ETA 4m.

incident-bot: notify: rollback complete on streaming pools at 03:44 UTC.

runtime_eng_lee: routing rule TTL expired; removed. double-checking no leftover force routes.

oncall_sre_ash: p95=0.9s, p99=1.6s now. SLOs restored for streaming. Customer errors dropped to baseline.

prod_support_jordan: updating customers: AcmeCorp confirms sessions look normal. sending post-incident note.

ops_manager_rita: great containment. Next: incident actions — (1) deep root-cause: why calibration produced 4% fallback tokens; (2) add canary gating for quant calibration jobs against representative long-context streaming traces; (3) add alert for "calib mismatch" log count > 1/min.

ml_infra_maya: taking action items 1 & 2. I'll create a follow-up runbook section on calibration health checks and add a regression test set.

runtime_eng_lee: I'll add a mitigation knob in the runtime to rate-limit fallback to dequant path to avoid cascade queuing next time.

oncall_sre_ash: final notes: incident closed at 03:52 UTC. Postmortem assigned to ml_infra_maya. Slack thread will be attached to the incident ticket.

prod_support_jordan: postmortem bullet for comms: timeline, customer list, mitigation steps, planned fixes.

se_customer_eng_arjun: thanks team. please ping when postmortem ready so I can share root cause with customers.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-328 resolved: status=mitigated, impact=partial customer session stalls, severity=P2. Follow-ups required.

ops_manager_rita: adding one more: run a simulated load test with mixed precision toggles during business hours to validate no regressions.

ml_infra_maya: noted. creating ticket: MIF-4572 (calib canary + regression suite).

oncall_sre_ash: thanks everyone for fast response.

runtime_eng_lee: :thumbsup: good ops.

prod_support_jordan: closing the loop with customers now.

se_customer_eng_arjun: I'll draft a brief technical summary for AcmeCorp and EduLabs.

end of thread
